in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Radhya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Radhya is the name of a Hindu goddess, the personification of love and beauty. She is the consort of Lord Krishna and is also known as Radha, the embodiment of the feminine divine.
